desc:

How to Play:
💣 You have 15 seconds to pass the bomb before it explodes!
🏃 Touch another player to pass the bomb and stay alive!
🗺️ The map changes every 15 minutes so explore the different maps!

Abilities & Shops:
🛒 Buy powerful abilities and cool cosmetics in the shop
⚡ Use abilities to escape, trick others, or survive longer!

Tips:
🔥 Find different strategies and juke your enemies!
🧠 Use your abilities wisely
😈 Trick other players & break their ankles!

Good luck… and don’t explode 💣💥
